## A. Rule vs compute at edges
A1 gap_ext_replacement_credit - 0.00-credit tiers get a priced credit. Rule/overwrite (l.2215, 2233): "...receives the replacement vehicle credit assembled here as a gap_benefit_paid entry with benefit_line_type replacement_vehicle_credit under the same claim number, where replacement_vehicle_credit_usd is above 0.00; every other holder whose GAP balance benefit has been paid receives replacement_vehicle_credit_usd toward a replacement vehicle bought from a group store in the same way." Compute (l.2275-2284): result = RND(MX(0, starting_credit + new_vehicle_bonus + store_bonus + deductible_reimbursement + price_bonus - setoff - credit_given)) whenever repl_type is set - no test of P('replacement_vehicle_credit_usd') > 0. Probe: Kessler GAP Waiver 150 (credit 0.00, window 0 days), GAP balance paid today, holder signs a contracted New Vehicle Retail Purchase today at the same store -> rule: 0.00 (replacement_vehicle_credit_usd); compute: 500.00 + 150.00 (+ price bonus) > 0.
A2 gap_ext_replacement_credit - two definitions of the loss date. Rule (l.2233): "the loss date is the one on the waiver's most recent GAP balance claim line, paid or denied" but also "The credit loss-age is whole calendar months from sale_date to the loss date of the paid line". Compute (l.2267, 2274-2275): line_loss_date = LATEST over all gap_balance lines (paid or denied), used for credit_age and the 36+ month unused share. Probe: a later gap_claim_denied gap_balance line (e.g. denial_reason waiver_not_active for a second loss on the settled waiver) with a different loss_date -> "loss date of the paid line" and compute differ.
A3 gap_ext_holder_cancellation_refund - month-end convention missing for unused whole months. Rule (l.991): "In counting the months a cancelled waiver was in force, a whole calendar month counts each time the start date's day of the month is reached; ... no month-end adjustment." This is scoped to months in force; the share ladder's "whole calendar months from the signed request date to expiration_date" and the sum-of-the-digits "unused whole months" (compute unused_months = MONTHS(signed_date, expiration_date), l.1030) have no stated convention. Probe: signed 2026-01-31, expiration 2030-02-28 -> MONTHS gives 48, a month-end reading gives 49. (The termination rule's "In counting a terminated waiver's months" covers both counts; the cancellation rule's wording does not.)
A4 gap_ext_balance_benefit - LTV ladder threshold rounding. Ladder (l.1392): "the amount financed is above ltv_cap_pct times the waiver's vehicle_value_basis" / "above ltv_cap_pct times the vehicle_value_basis by no more than ltv_tolerance_pct of that figure" (unrounded). Compute (l.1425-1426): recorded_cap_amount = RND(ltv_cap_pct * vehicle_value_basis, 2) is the threshold. Probe: vehicle_value_basis 30000.03, ltv_cap_pct 1.25 -> 37500.0375 vs 37500.04; amount financed 37500.04 is "above" by the rule, not above by compute.
A5 gap_ext_addon_overpayment_recovery - "first" refund read as the latest. Rule (l.1621): "where such a refund reached the lienholder before the paid line was paid ...; where none reached it before the payment and the first reached it within claim_payment_days calendar days after the payment". Compute first_refund_paid (l.1667) = MN of each product's XLATEST refund-paid entry_date (latest per product, not earliest). Latent: differs only when one product has two lienholder refund-paid rows.
A6 gap_ext_lienholder_refund_release - absent completed request. Compute (l.1241, 1248): recorded_stamp = LATEST(... request_status='completed') or effective_date, so with no completed request the courtesy credit is tiered on the effective date. Rule courtesy ladder (l.1209) has tiers only for "the signed request was recorded ..."; no stated tier for a waiver with no completed request. Latent (charter cancellations always carry a request).

## B. Framing clause asserting a fact no record holds (recipe 11)
B1 gap_ext_addon_overpayment_recovery (l.1620): "a refund paid on a cancellation for a reason other than total_loss or deal_unwound carried its product's cancellation fee, which a total-loss refund does not". Not always true under the vsc/maintenance charters (a customer_request cancellation inside the free look, or any flat refund, carries no fee); no record shows whether a fee was deducted. The ladder itself (fee added where the reason is customer_request or vehicle_sold_or_traded) can stand without this clause.

## C. Assembly / overwrite sentences naming factor quantities (recipe 3) - every policy
C1 holder_cancellation_refund replaced_by + rule (l.972, 991): "any amount withheld from the price comes off the retail_price before the unused share is applied, the unused share follows the share ladder below, and the effective-date adjustment, itself rounded half up to the cent, and every charge are applied after that rounding"; also l.969 "the effective date follows the effective-date ladder below".
C2 lienholder_refund_release (l.1195, 1210): "the release is one payment of the refund due plus the late-release interest and the courtesy credit described here"; "The late-release interest is the refund due times the interest rate plus any rate premium, ... and any courtesy credit is added after that rounding."
C3 balance_benefit (l.1365, 1368, 1371): "the covered-deductible amount the deductible ladder below selects"; "past-due payments less the past-due allowance, late fees and charges less the late-charge allowance, deferred or extended payments as the deferral ladder below treats them"; "ltv_cap_pct times the cap basis the cap-basis ladder below selects ... by the reduction method the loan-to-value ladder below selects". (The closing order sentence l.1392 is generic and fine.)
C4 addon_overpayment_recovery (l.1621): "each product's refund is counted as its timing or restatement ladder counts it, the fee add-back is added, ..., the late-payment interest owed and the stale-payoff waiver are subtracted from the overpayment but never take it below one half of the overpayment"; also "The late-payment interest owed is ... set against the overpayment".
C5 payoff_termination_refund (l.1814, 1832): "any administrator portion comes off the retail_price ..., the unused termination share follows the termination share ladder below, the termination charge takes the place of cancellation_fee_usd as the termination-charge ladder below selects, and the bundle recapture, the backdating credit and the trade-in credit are applied after the rounding"; closing sentence "the administrator portion comes off ..., the termination charge and any bundle recapture are subtracted, the backdating credit, rounded half up to the cent, and the trade-in credit are added"; l.1811 "with the effective date the backdating ladder below selects".
C6 holder_refund_release (l.2038, 2054): "the release is one payment of the refund due plus the holder late interest, the payoff courtesy credit and the tenure goodwill credit described here"; "...interest rate plus any rate premium, ... and the payoff courtesy credit and the tenure goodwill credit are added after that rounding."
C7 replacement_credit (l.2234): "the starting credit is set by the credit-age ladder, the bonuses and the deductible reimbursement are added".
Effect: the computation document cannot carry these sentences without naming factor quantities, and splitting them into factor documents makes factor documents name the order relative to each other.

## D. Quantity only one factor uses sits in a plain binding (recipe 4) / factor claims a baseline read
D1 recovery: late_pay_credit (plain, l.1666) and the half-of-overpayment floor in result (l.1669) are nonzero/binding only under prompt_pay_rate_tier / stale_payoff_tier; baseline rule never mentions them.
D2 cancellation: unused_months, term_months and the whole-month / sum-of-digits branches of unused_share (plain, l.1030-1032) only serve share_convention; recorded_stamp (l.1014) only serves eff_date_rule; request_reason only cancel_charge_tier.
D3 balance: recorded_cap_amount (l.1425) only serves ltv_reduction_tier; settlement_date only late_charge_allowance_tier. Reverse: factor-claimed bindings deferred (deferral_treatment) and ltv_trade_payoff / ltv_trade_allowance (ltv_reduction_tier) are read by the baseline (deferral baseline, negative_equity l.1427).
D4 replacement: credit_age and line_loss_date only serve credit_age_rule; line_paid_date only new_vehicle_bonus_tier. lienholder release: signed_date only release_late_window.
